design: Retain all2668rows of the corrected positive-proposal curriculum. Both arms append the same three source-resolution reviewed background crops repeated4times. Control retains parent teacher outputs on these12rows with weight1; corrected uses explicit background labels with weight4. Only these12supervision rows differ; graph, initialization perseed, pixels, optimizer, schedule and all prior labels match. Exact pixel duplicates with any prior curriculum row are forbidden to avoid conflicting retention targets. Hypothesis: native-photo evidence distinguishes deflated latex, chair upholstery and a cap from inflated blue balloons without additional inference cost.
gate: Verify fixed final models, optimizer steps, matched tensors and reproduce stored predictions. Replay both seeds on82TRAIN scenes using unchanged current and direct-hybrid policies. Require no incumbent target loss, no per-color false-positive increase on any panel and strict recovery or false-positive reduction in both seeds before separate export/DEV investigation. Report matched-control effects and old-crop losses. No deployment from TRAIN and no threshold sweep.
